jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager - Franchise
jobs.description:
The Senior Sales Manager is responsible for driving revenue and market share for the resort through the development and management of Corporate Group and Individual Business Travel (IBT) accounts. This position will focus on identifying new business opportunities, building strong client relationships, generating group room nights and event revenue, and positioning the resort as a premier destination for corporate group and individual business traveler experiences.

The ideal candidate is a highly motivated sales professional who thrives in a relationship-driven environment and is comfortable spending significant time developing new business. This role requires a proactive approach to outside sales, networking, client entertainment, prospecting, and solicitation calls, as well as the ability to effectively manage the sales process from initial lead through contract and turnover.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Sales & Business Development

- Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve or exceed assigned room night, revenue, and booking goals within the Corporate Group and IBT markets.

- Identify, prospect, and cultivate new corporate group business and individual business travel accounts.

- Conduct consistent outside sales calls, prospecting calls and solicitation calls to generate new business.

- Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified group and corporate accounts.

- Research target markets and identify companies and organizations that align with the resort's ideal customer profile.

- Develop relationships with meeting planners, corporate travel managers, incentive planners, destination management companies (DMCs), third-party planners and other key industry contacts.

- Conduct property tours and client presentations that effectively showcase the resort's accommodations, meeting facilities, amenities, and destination offerings.

- Prepare proposals, negotiate contracts, and close business in accordance with resort guidelines and revenue objectives.

- Maintain accurate and timely records of sales activities, account information, leads, proposals, and opportunities within the hotel's Delphi sales system.

Corporate Group & IBT Sales

- Develop a strong presence within the corporate group and individual business travel markets.

- Target companies and organizations with executive retreats, incentive programs, board meetings, leadership meetings, conferences, and corporate events.

- Develop long-term relationships with meeting planning companies and corporate decision-makers.

- Identify opportunities to increase total resort revenue through guestrooms, meeting space, food and beverage, activities, and other resort experiences.

- Partner with operations and event teams to ensure a seamless transition from sales to event execution.

Networking and Outside Sales

- Represent the resort at industry networking events, trade shows, conferences and client events.

- Participate in local, regional, and national industry organizations to increase awareness of the resort.

- Develop a consistent schedule of face-to-face client appointments and outside sales calls.

- Conduct client entertainment and relationship-building activities as appropriate.

- Develop strategic partnerships with local businesses, DMCs, tourism organizations, and other destination partners.

Account Management

- Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing accounts to encourage repeat business and increased production.

- Conduct regular account reviews and identify opportunities for additional business.

- Maintain detailed account profiles and sales activity within Delphi.

- Provide exceptional customer service throughout the sales process and serve as a trusted resource for clients.

Sales Leadership

- Serve as a resource and sales leader for team members, sharing successful prospecting strategies, market intelligence, client relationship techniques and best practices.

- Provide guidance and support to Sales Managers in developing new accounts, expanding existing relationships, and increasing total resort revenue.

- Lead by example through consistent outside sales activity, prospecting, networking, client engagement and successful account development.

- Support a culture of accountability, collaboration, professionalism and continuous improvement within the sales department.

Internal Collaboration

- Work closely with the Director of Sales, Revenue Management, Catering/Conference Services, Front Office, Food & Beverage, and Resort Operations teams.

- Communicate client needs and expectations clearly to operational teams.

- Participate in internal meetings as needed.

- Assist with sales initiatives, promotions, packages, and marketing campaigns designed to generate corporate group and individual business traveler business.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

- Achieve or exceed assigned group room night and revenue goals.

- Generate qualified new business through proactive prospecting.

- Increase production within the Corporate Group and IBT segments.

- Build a strong and diversified account base.

- Maintain a consistent schedule of outside sales and solicitation activity.

- Develop meaningful relationships with corporate and industry decision-makers.

- Increase resort awareness within key feeder markets.

- Convert qualified leads into contracted business.

- Drive total resort revenue through guestrooms, meetings, food and beverage and ancillary resort experiences.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES):

- 3+ years of hotel, resort, hospitality, destination, or related sales experience, preferably with a focus on corporate group and individual business travel.

- Experience with proactive prospecting, outside sales, networking, and account development.

- Strong understanding of the corporate group and individual business travel markets.

- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and closing skills.

- Strong relationship-building and networking abilities.

- Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with a team.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability and willingness to travel for sales calls, trade shows, networking events and client meetings.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Delphi systems.

- Hospitality degree or related education preferred, but equivalent experience will be considered.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a hunter-style sales professional who is energized by developing new relationships and creating business opportunities. They are confident making cold calls, scheduling face-to-face appointments, attending networking events, and representing the resort in the marketplace.

They understand that successful resort sales require more than responding to incoming leads—they proactively get in front of clients, build relationships, create demand and close business.

The successful candidate will be personable, polished, persistent, highly organized, and comfortable representing the resort and the New Mexico destination to corporate clients.

Physical Requirements, Work Environment & Travel

This is a highly active sales leadership position requiring regular time both on property and in the marketplace. The Senior Sales Manager is expected to maintain a visible presence throughout the property while actively pursuing new business, managing client relationships, attending industry events, and representing the property in the local and regional marketplace.

Physical Requirements:

- Position requires approximately 25% standing, 25% walking, and 50% sitting.

- Ability to lift and/or carry up to 25 pounds as needed.

- Regular movement throughout the property, including guest areas, meeting and event spaces, kitchens, dining areas and other operational areas.

Work Environment & Travel:

- Regularly works both on property and in the marketplace, including outside sales calls, client appointments, site tours, networking events, trade shows, community events and other business development activities.

- Some evening, weekend, and holiday work is required to accommodate client needs, industry events, property functions, and business development opportunities.

- Regional and occasional national travel may be required for trade shows, client meetings, industry conferences and other business development activities.

- The Senior Sales Manager may be required to respond to 24-hour emergency or business-critical calls when necessary to support the property, clients or sales operations.

- The role requires the ability to maintain a professional and customer-focused presence while operating in a fast-paced, high-energy hospitality environment and adapting to changing business and client needs.

Compensation

Salary:  Competitive base salary commensurate with experience
Incentive:  Performance-based sales incentive/bonus opportunity
Benefits:  Eligible for resort/company benefits, subject to applicable plan terms

The resort is an equal opportunity employer and values a diverse and inclusive workplace.

jobs.title: Director, Brand F&B Concept Development Luxury & Lifestyle - Asia Pacific
jobs.description:
As Director, Brand Food & Beverage (F&B) Concept Development Luxury & Lifestyle – Asia Pacific (APAC), you will lead the creative and bespoke arm of F&B brand development across Hilton's luxury and lifestyle portfolio in APAC, developing well-defined, one-of-a-kind F&B concepts that strengthen brand recognition, elevate the guest experience and create tangible value for owners.
You will conduct market research to determine regional suitability, competitive positioning, target audience and economic viability for each concept, and work closely with internal Architecture & Design, Operations and Technical Services teams to guide owners' project teams through every F&B-related decision. This is a hands-on role within a small, close-knit team: you will operate as an individual contributor delivering original creative work yourself, while also managing day-to-day tasks and priorities across the wider team. Excellent communication skills are essential, you will be a primary voice to owners, senior stakeholders and internal partners as well as to your own team.
WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT
You have these minimum qualifications:
- Degree in Interior Design, Hospitality, F&B Management or a related field, with significant hospitality or F&B experience.
- 7+ years of restaurant design or F&B concept development experience, including 4+ years in a senior creative or F&B design leadership capacity. Ideally in the luxury or lifestyle segment.
- Demonstrated ability to translate brand strategy into distinctive, ownership-ready bespoke concepts.
- Strong knowledge of F&B operations, service techniques and current global F&B trends and concepts in the luxury and lifestyle space.
- Ability to think creatively and pair design ability with F&B operations experience.
- Ability to convey mood, narrative and brand story through the selection and use of imagery and materials.
- Excellent visual, written and oral communication skills, with the ability to interact with and influence senior stakeholders, present persuasively, and communicate clearly with a small, close-knit team.
- Comfortable operating as an individual contributor on a small team – equally capable of hands-on creative delivery and of managing day-to-day tasks and priorities for the wider team.
- Ability to deliver presentations in a concise, well-organized and persuasive manner.
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent concepts under deadline pressure.
- Ability to adapt to extensive regional travel and schedule changes.
- Absolute discretion and confidentiality regarding sensitive ownership and brand information.
- Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint, Adobe InDesign or any other creative presentation tool.

It would be useful if you have:
- Experience in or knowledge of Restaurant Design.

- Experience in or knowledge of the luxury and lifestyle segment of the market.

- Global F&B operational management experience.

- Restaurant Front of House (FOH) service operations.
HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT
Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique.
What your day-to-day will be like:
- Strategically assess the project, market and guest profile before recommending the F&B concept strategy for a property.
- Ensure concepts that are proposed are aligned with the regional F&B operations team and will drive strong commercial returns.
- Develop well-defined, bespoke F&B concepts for luxury and lifestyle brands across pipeline, renovation and conversion hotels.
- Own the full creative arc of a concept – narrative, culinary and beverage direction, service ritual, mood and spatial storytelling – in partnership with Architecture & Design.
- Conduct and regularly refresh market research to determine regional suitability of concepts, competitive set, target audience and economic factors.
- Prepare and present detailed, ownership-ready F&B concept briefs to owners and their representatives.
- Identify and evaluate brand-relevant restaurant operators and concept partners, reviewing financial acumen and fit for business, and advise ownership accordingly.
- Evaluate and identify new business opportunities for additional bespoke concepts.
- Track progress and compliance of concept initiatives against the project board; determine working schedules and task completion dates based on project deadlines.
- Manage day-to-day tasks, priorities and workflow across the small F&B concept development team, keeping deliverables on track.

How you will collaborate with others:
- Ensure coordination among key stakeholders – Hotel Operations, Technical Services, Architecture & Design, in support of concept development and the design process.
- Build and maintain strong business relationships with senior owners, asset managers and operators, serving as the primary regional creative contact for bespoke F&B concept development.
- Contribute to brand standards review and updates in partnership with Brand Heads and F&B Operations.

What projects or deliverables you will take ownership of:
- Direct and mentor supporting creative/design Team Member(s) in the execution of concept briefs, establishing work priorities, while remaining hands-on and personally delivering creative work as an individual contributor.
- Participate in Brand F&B Development special projects as team lead, keeping constituents updated on related activity.
- Assist the Senior Director F&B – APAC in achieving strategic and department goals, and support ad-hoc projects as needed.

jobs.title: Catering Sales Manager - NoMad Detroit
jobs.description:
The Catering Sales Manager will actively prospect for new business, respond to and qualify inquiries, develop creative proposals, conduct site visits, negotiate contracts, and manage the sales process through conversion. Once business is confirmed, the Manager will serve as the primary client contact through the planning and execution process, coordinating closely with Banquets, Food & Beverage, Culinary, Front Office, Engineering, and other hotel departments and vendors to ensure seamless event delivery.
The ideal candidate is a proactive and results-oriented salesperson with excellent relationship-building skills, strong negotiation abilities, exceptional attention to detail, and the organizational discipline required to manage multiple events and priorities simultaneously.
- Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field preferred.

- 3+ years of experience in hotel catering sales, event sales, hospitality sales, or a related field; luxury or upper-upscale hotel experience strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated success in generating new business and achieving sales or revenue goals.

- Proven experience managing the full sales cycle, including prospecting, qualification, proposal development, negotiation, contracting, and closing.

- Experience selling and servicing both corporate and social events preferred.

- Strong understanding of catering, banquet operations, event planning, and hotel operations.

- Exceptional relationship-building, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

- Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple events, clients, and deadlines simultaneously.

- Strong business-development mindset with the confidence and persistence to actively prospect for new business.

- Ability to build trust and maintain long-term relationships with clients and industry partners.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, particularly in a fast-paced event environment.

- Ability to remain composed and service-oriented while managing changing client needs and time-sensitive situations.

- Strong financial acumen and understanding of event pricing, profitability, contracts, and revenue management principles.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with hotel sales and catering systems/CRM platforms.

- Professional, polished, and service-oriented demeanor appropriate for a luxury hospitality environment.

- Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays based on event schedules and business needs.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
- Actively prospect for new corporate and social catering business through outbound sales efforts, networking, referrals, partnerships, industry events, local market research, community events and other business-development activities.

- Develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective catering business and consistently pursue opportunities to achieve or exceed revenue goals.

- Respond to incoming event inquiries in a timely, professional, and personalized manner.

- Qualify leads based on event requirements, guest count, date, budget, revenue potential, and overall fit with the hotel.

- Conduct sales presentations, site inspections, client meetings, tastings, and event consultations.

- Develop creative proposals and customized event experiences that align with client objectives while maximizing hotel revenue.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, meeting planners, event professionals, social clients, wedding and special-event contacts, and local community partners.

- Identify opportunities to generate repeat business, referrals, and additional revenue from existing accounts and clients.

- Maintain an in-depth understanding of the hotel’s event spaces, culinary offerings, amenities, services, and competitive positioning.

- Stay informed about local market trends, competitor activity, seasonal demand, and emerging opportunities within the corporate and social events markets.
SALES PROGRESS & NEGOTIATION

- Manage the full sales cycle from initial inquiry and qualification through contracting, deposit, final details, event execution, and post-event follow-up.

- Prepare and present proposals, estimates, menus, packages, and contracts in accordance with hotel standards and revenue objectives.

- Negotiate rates, menus, packages, minimums, concessions, and other contract terms while protecting hotel profitability and brand standards.

- Maintain accurate and timely records of leads, opportunities, contracts, revenue, and client activity within the hotel’s sales and catering systems. Monitor sales pipeline, conversion, pace, and production against established goals.

- Follow up consistently with prospects and clients to maximize conversion and ensure no viable business opportunity is overlooked.

- Ensure all contracts and event details are accurate, complete, and communicated appropriately to the operational team.
EVENT PLANNING & SERVICE

- Develop detailed event plans and ensure all client requirements, preferences, timelines, and special requests are accurately documented and communicated.

- Coordinate menus, room setups, audiovisual requirements, décor, entertainment, transportation, amenities, and other event components as applicable.

- Conduct planning meetings and event reviews with clients and internal hotel teams.

- Coordinate closely with Banquets, Culinary, Food & Beverage, Front Office, Engineering, Housekeeping, Security, and other departments to ensure seamless execution.

- Monitor event progress and serve as a key point of contact for the client during event execution.

- Anticipate client needs and proactively resolve challenges or changes before and during events.

- Ensure the client experience consistently reflects the hotel’s luxury service standards.

- Conduct post-event follow-up to gather feedback, address outstanding items, and identify opportunities for future business.

- Maintain strong relationships with clients beyond the individual event to encourage repeat and referral business.
REVENUE & PERFORMANCE

- Achieve or exceed individual catering sales and revenue goals.

- Develop business that supports overall hotel occupancy, food and beverage revenue, and profitability objectives.

- Identify opportunities to maximize event revenue through menu enhancements, upgrades, ancillary services, and additional event components.

- Monitor individual sales performance, conversion, average spend, and other relevant KPIs.

- Provide accurate forecasts and updates regarding event pace, pipeline, and anticipated revenue.

- Partner with Revenue Management and Sales Team to ensure business is evaluated based on overall value, profitability, and hotel strategy.
QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

- Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field preferred.

- 3+ years of experience in hotel catering sales, event sales, hospitality sales, or a related field; luxury or upper-upscale hotel experience strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated success in generating new business and achieving sales or revenue goals.

- Proven experience managing the full sales cycle, including prospecting, qualification, proposal development, negotiation, contracting, and closing.

- Experience selling and servicing both corporate and social events preferred.

- Strong understanding of catering, banquet operations, event planning, and hotel operations.

- Exceptional relationship-building, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

- Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple events, clients, and deadlines simultaneously.

jobs.description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA
Join an in-house Brands team with expertise in hospitality, brand management, innovation, owner relations, and more across Hilton's portfolio. As Senior Director, Brand Management - Home2 Suites, you will help grow one of Hilton's leading brands and shape Hilton's extended stay positioning. Reporting to the Vice President, Brand Leader, Extended Stay Brands, you will translate strategy into action, advance performance across key brand indicators, and lead initiatives that improve the guest experience, support owner returns, and protect long-term brand integrity.
What you'll do during a typical day:
- Partner with the Brand Leader to shape short- and long-term strategies, priorities, annual plans, and roadmaps, then lead cross-functional project plans that bring them to life.
- Advance strategies to achieve KPIs and strengthen brand integrity for Home2 Suites and the extended stay portfolio. Plan projects, manage priorities, monitor key measures, analyze data, identify gaps, and recommend actions that improve results.
- Lead brand and extended stay initiatives across product, service, food and beverage, technology, sustainability, and hotel operations, with clear objectives, timelines, budgets, and success measures.
- Serve as a visible Home2 Suites advocate with owners, hotel leaders, internal partners, and industry audiences through presentations, meetings, conferences, and brand events.

How you'll collaborate with others:
- Work across Commercial, Marketing, Development, Architecture, Design & Construction, Brand Performance Support, Owner Relations, Brand Standards, Quality Assurance, Openings, Communications, and Learning to align priorities and execute brand plans.
- Build trusted relationships with owners, franchisees, hotel leaders, and advisory groups, using data, business cases, and expertise to gain support and drive adoption
- Develop executive-ready presentations, communications, training materials, and field content that translate strategy into clear actions for internal and external audiences.

Deliverables you'll take ownership of:
- Lead strategic Home2 Suites initiatives from project charter and business case through design, implementation, field communication, performance tracking, and optimization.
- Own brand performance updates, competitive and market assessments, annual planning inputs, and budget and forecast support.
- Lead content and project management for owner and hotel leader forums, field webinars, and enterprise, development, regional, and brand conferences.
- Organize and attend meetings and visits with owners, operators, and hotel teams.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

- Eight (8) years of experience in brand management, hospitality, strategy, operations, commercial disciplines, development, or a related field.
- Four (4) years leading complex projects with multiple partners in a matrixed organization.
- Experience developing strategy, building business cases, gaining support, and driving implementation from concept through execution.
- Experience building executive-ready content and presenting to senior leaders, owners, hotel leaders, and internal and external audiences.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

- Two (2) years of experience working in brand management or brand/franchise development.
- Experience developing annual plans, budgets, forecasts, narratives, project plans, and strategic roadmaps for a large enterprise.

jobs.title: Director of Sales South India – Hilton Worldwide Sales (HWS) India (Bangalore based)
jobs.description:
The Director of Sales South India – Hilton Worldwide Sales (HWS) India will be responsible for driving global account sales efforts across Hilton’s global portfolio of hotels. This role will lead a team of face-to-face sales professionals located across the country, with the objective of generating business from a portfolio of accounts based in India. The role holder will be responsible for achieving revenue targets, growing market share, and strengthening customer relationships.
Reporting to the Regional Director – HWS India, this position will develop and execute sales strategies aligned to Hilton’s broader commercial objectives. The role will also be responsible for managing a portfolio of customer-facing accounts, building strong relationships with key clients, and collaborating with internal stakeholders to deliver commercial success.
WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT
You have these minimum qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS)

- Minimum 10 years of experience, preferably in hospitality sales

- Proven leadership experience, including managing and developing large or distributed teams

- Experience in the hotel, travel and leisure industry

- Ability to create and develop highly motivated, high-performing sales teams

- Experience in developing and implementing strategic plans

- Experience in facilitation, negotiation, conflict resolution, and a demonstrated ability to lead and manage others through influence and collaboration within a matrixed environment

- Ability to analyse data and develop compelling business cases, with strong influencing skills to present findings and propose strategic and tactical recommendations to senior leaders

- Sensitivity and ability to maintain the privacy and confidentiality of information, protect the assets of the Company, act with ethics and integrity, and adhere to the Company’s Code of Conduct and policies and procedures

It would be useful if you have:
- Advanced degree is preferred

- Significant experience working in India, with a deep understanding of regional business practices and cultural nuances

- Significant experience within progressive sales leadership at a multi-site, multi-branded, consumer-focused organisation

- Experience managing sizeable revenue streams across diverse customers, brands, and channels

- Relevant sales experience could be a combination of business-to-business, business-to-consumer, or business-to-business-to-consumer

- Exposure to franchisee businesses would be advantageous
HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT
Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique.
Directing Activities
- Achieve revenue goals that include building business and driving market share

- Retain and expand sales opportunities through the sales team to produce substantial revenue growth

- Personally manage a portfolio of key accounts to drive high-value business

- Support the management of key accounts to ensure alignment with broader sales strategies

- Work closely with the Regional Director – HWS India to align strategies and ensure cohesive execution

Planning Activities
- Develop and implement sales plans within the team to meet and exceed performance targets

- Strategise approaches to sales proposals and business development opportunities

- Provide recommendations based on extensive understanding of the local market and industry trends

- Support new hotel openings within India by contributing to pre-opening sales planning and execution

People Activities
- Responsible for hiring, mentoring, and managing a team of sales professionals

- Foster a high-performance culture through coaching, development, recognition, and regular feedback

- Demonstrate the highest standards of ethical behaviour and absolute discretion with sensitive information

Organising Activities
- Coordinate and organise trade shows, roadshows, and other customer engagement events

- Attend Commercial Meetings and Management Exchanges as required to represent and contribute to strategic discussions

- Support additional functions within the broader sales organisation as appropriate

- Provide ongoing training opportunities for the sales team to enhance their skills and performance

- Set performance goals for the sales team and monitor their progress

Monitoring Activities
- Maintain a close, accessible relationship with hotels and other internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and responsiveness

This role contributes to revenue growth across Rooms, Meetings & Events, Food & Drinks, and other hotel offerings while delivering exceptional service that reflects Waldorf Astoria's commitment to luxury and excellence.

A Sales Manager - Corporate serving for the Waldorf Astoria Dubai International Financial Centre is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:
•    Previous experience in a luxury hotel in the UAE with strong knowledge of the corporate segment

•    Commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with genuine care and attention to detail

•    Excellent personal presentation and grooming standards

•    Flexibility to adapt to changing business needs and priorities

•    Masters Degree in Hospitality Management

•    Ability to budget and forecast
•    Familiarity with Hilton systems and global sales processes is a plus
•    Passion for hospitality, sales excellence, and exceeding guest expectations
•    Multilingual capabilities will be considered an asset
What will it be like to work for Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts?
Waldorf Astoria provides guests the exceptional environment and the personalized attention of True Waldorf Service that creates a singular experience. If you understand the value of personalized attention and know how to treat even the most extraordinarily different experiences with the same rich level of customer service, you may just be the person we are looking for!

jobs.title: MICE Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Are you passionate about sales, relationship-building, and creating memorable customer experiences? Do you thrive on networking, identifying new business opportunities, and turning prospects into long-term partnerships? If so, we would love to hear from you.
As MICE Sales Manager, you will play a key role in driving revenue growth within the Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Events (MICE) segment. You will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing strong client relationships, and implementing sales strategies that support the hotel's commercial objectives.
The Ideal candidate has a proven track record in MICE sales, enjoys proactive business development, and is motivated by exceeding targets while delivering exceptional customer experiences.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for a motivated and relationship-focused sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced and competitive environment. You are creative, solution-oriented, and passionate about creating business opportunities and delivering results.
To be successful in this role, you will have:
- At least two years of experience in a MICE sales role or similar business development sales position.
- A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Swedish and English.
- Strong negotiation, networking, and relationship-building skills.
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative team environment.
- Knowledge of the local MICE markets is considered an advantage.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Experience with Salesforce or another CRM system is considered an advantage.

Additional Information
This is a full-time position. Working hours are primarily Monday- Friday but may occasionally include evenings and weekends based on business needs.
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, we therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
Key Responsibilities:
- Drive MICE business into the hotel through proactive sales activities and strategic business development.
- Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and performance targets.
- Build, manage, and grow relationships with key accounts, agencies, and prospective clients.
- Maintain clear account plans, call objectives, and follow-up activities for assigned accounts and prospects.
- Identify, qualify, and convert new business opportunities through proactive prospecting and lead generation.
- Negotiate contracts, determine rates, and manage client accounts throughout the sales process.
- Monitor and analyze lost business opportunities to identify trends and areas for improvement.
- Maximize revenue by ensuring all sales opportunities are followed up and converted effectively.
- Represent the hotel at trade shows, workshops, networking events, sales blitzes, and client site inspections.
- Deliver professional presentations and act as an ambassador for Hilton Stockholm Slussen to prospective clients and partners.
Hilton Stockholm Slussen is looking for a positive, innovate, and commercially driven MICE Sales Manager to join our sales team.

jobs.title: Sales Manager - Franchise
jobs.description:
We exist to create unforgettable experiences for every guest, every time. Behind every memorable stay is a strong commercial strategy, and our Sales team plays a vital role in bringing new guests through our doors while building lasting partnerships within our community and beyond.

What You'll Do

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with local, national, and international clients to generate business across all key market segments, including Corporate, MICE, Group, Leisure, and Consortia.

- Create and implement strategic sales plans to maximise revenue opportunities and grow market share.

- Proactively identify and secure new business opportunities through networking, prospecting, sales calls, and client meetings.

- Conduct hotel presentations, site inspections, and familiarisation visits to showcase the hotel and its facilities.

- Represent the hotel at trade shows, industry events, networking functions, and client entertainment activities.

- Drive revenue growth from existing accounts while continuously developing new client relationships.

- Research emerging markets, identify new business opportunities, and expand the hotel's presence into new sectors and territories.

- Prepare and manage quotations, contracts, proposals, and sales correspondence, ensuring accuracy and timely follow-up.

- Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer feedback to inform sales strategies and commercial decisions.

- Work closely with the General Manager and Director of Sales to review performance, pricing strategies, and business opportunities.

- Collaborate with Revenue, Reservations, Operations, and Marketing teams to deliver a seamless customer journey.

- Maintain accurate records and account activity within relevant sales and CRM systems.

- Achieve agreed sales targets and contribute to the overall commercial success of the hotel.

What We're Looking For

- A passionate sales professional with proven proactive sales experience within a hotel or hospitality environment who thrives on building relationships and securing new business opportunities.

- Strong knowledge of key hotel business segments including Corporate, MICE, Group, Leisure, and Consortia.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage with clients at all levels.

- Ability to develop strategic sales plans and deliver measurable commercial results.

- Strong negotiation and influencing skills with a customer-focused approach.

- A proactive, self-motivated individual who can manage multiple priorities effectively.

- Working knowledge of Delphi, Salesforce, and OnQ systems is desirable.

- Computer literacy, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- Strong understanding of revenue management principles and market analysis.

- Flexibility to travel regularly for client meetings, trade shows, and industry events.

- Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

- Competitive salary plus discretionary annual bonus.

- Discounted hotel stays and dining across Hilton properties worldwide.

- Complimentary welcome stay experience.

- Access to learning, development, and apprenticeship opportunities.

- Recognition programmes and team celebrations.

- Supportive and inclusive working environment.

- Convenient parking for cars, mopeds, scooters, and bicycles.

誰かの1日を明るくする姿を想像してみてください。当ホテルチームの一員になれば、まさに毎日、そんな体験ができるのです！担当する法人顧客の管理、新規事業の開拓、客室、ケータリング、飲食部門からのホテル全体の収益向上、ビジネスニーズへの対応、新たなビジネスチャンスの開拓、そしてプロモーション活動や販売チャネルを通じた既存事業の拡大など、多岐にわたる業務を担当していただきます。セールスマネージャー／アシスタントセールスマネージャー／シニアセールスマネージャーとして、単に団体客の売上を創出し管理するだけでなく、すべてのお客様に忘れられない滞在体験を提供することで、ホスピタリティの温かさと輝きを広げていくのです。
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a  Sales Manager/Assistant Sales Manager/Senior Sales Manager , you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
ヒルトンでは、コアバリューが成功に必要な要素を明確にし、すべてのチームメンバーに求める資質を導きます。
ホスピタリティの光と温かさを広める情熱。誠実に行動し、常に正しいことを行うこと。リーダーシップを通して他者を鼓舞すること。チームワークこそが最良の結果を生み出すという信念。オーナーシップと責任感。そして、今この瞬間に集中し、あらゆる瞬間に迅速さと規律をもって取り組み、それが永続的な影響を与えることを理解すること。

さらに、この職​​務には以下の最低限の資格が必要です。
*ホスピタリティ、ビジネス、または関連分野の学位または卒業証書
*ホテルにおける法人、MICE、または団体客室販売の実務経験3年以上
*収益向上と主要顧客管理における実績
*優れた交渉力、プレゼンテーション能力、および関係構築能力
*ホテルシステム（例：Delphi、Salesforce、OnQ、Market Planner Survey）に関する高度な技術スキル
*販売データと市場動向を分析し、戦略策定に役立てる能力
*優れたコミュニケーション能力とリーダーシップ、そして協調性
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
- Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
- Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
- Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
- Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
- Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
- Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
- Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset
典型的な一日の業務内容は以下のとおりです。
*見込み顧客へのホテル代表としての対応：グループルーム、会議室、飲食サービスをお探しの顧客にとって、主要な窓口となります。
*新規ビジネス機会の創出：問い合わせへの対応、新規顧客へのアプローチ、見込み客の選定、積極的な営業活動による潜在顧客の獲得を行います。
*販売サイクル全体の管理：施設訪問、顧客接待、提案書の作成、料金設定、契約交渉、そして契約履行までのアカウント管理を行います。
*戦略的な販売計画の策定：収益目標と客室稼働率目標を達成または上回るための戦略を策定・実行し、業績と市場状況に応じて調整します。
*販売実績の分析：失注レポートを評価し、コンバージョン率と競争力を強化する機会を特定します。
*卓越したサービス提供のサポート：各部門と連携し、契約サービスの履行を調整し、最高水準の顧客満足度を維持します。
*チームの育成とモチベーション向上：チームメンバーの監督とサポート、業績のモニタリング、コーチング、そして前向きで生産的な職場環境の醸成を行います。
Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
- Represent the hotel to prospective clients:   Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
- Drive new business opportunities:   Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
- Manage the full sales cycle:   Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
- Develop strategic sales plans:   Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
- Analyze sales performance:   Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
- Support exceptional service delivery:   Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
- Inspire and develop the team:   Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

jobs.title: Hotel Sales Manager - Franchise
jobs.description:
Sales Manager – New Home2 Suites by Hilton | West Middlesex, PA

Be part of something new! We are seeking an energetic, motivated, and results-driven Sales Manager to join our team for the opening of the new Home2 Suites by Hilton in West Middlesex, PA.

As Sales Manager, you will play a key role in introducing our hotel to the local market and building a strong foundation for long-term success. You will be responsible for developing new business, maintaining relationships with existing accounts, and creating sales strategies that drive occupancy and revenue.

The ideal candidate is a relationship builder who enjoys connecting with businesses, organizations, and community partners and has a passion for hospitality and delivering exceptional guest experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve hotel revenue and occupancy goals.

- Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the local and regional markets.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate accounts, group clients, travel partners, and community organizations.

- Conduct sales calls, client visits, networking, and community outreach.

- Manage accounts and maintain accurate records of sales activity and opportunities.

- Coordinate group, corporate, and extended-stay business from initial contact through completion.

- Partner with hotel leadership and operations teams to ensure an exceptional guest experience.

- Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities for growth.

- Represent the hotel professionally at community events, industry functions, and networking opportunities.

What We’re Looking For:

- Previous hotel sales or hospitality experience preferred.

- Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

- Self-motivated, organized, and goal-oriented.

- Ability to develop and maintain a strong local business network.

- Professional and enthusiastic approach to customer service.

- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with the hotel team.

This is an exciting opportunity to help launch a brand-new hotel and make a lasting impact in the West Middlesex market . If you are a driven hospitality professional who enjoys building relationships and growing business, we’d love to hear from you!


Join our team as Sales Manager for the exciting opening of the new Home2 Suites by Hilton in West Middlesex, PA! We’re looking for a motivated hospitality sales professional to drive revenue, build strong relationships with local businesses and organizations, and help establish our new hotel as a preferred destination for business and leisure travelers.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager - Leisure
jobs.description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
The location for this position virtual/remote (within the U.S.) or Puerto Rico (The Hilton Caribe)
The Senior Leisure Sales Manager leads efforts to expand and strengthen the hotel's leisure market presence by developing strategic partnerships with Wholesale, Consortia, and Cruise Lines accounts. You will support the Hilton Caribe and report to the Director of Sales. Through proactive business development, customer engagement, contract negotiations, and industry networking, you will increase revenue while delivering exceptional service to clients. You will travel frequently to cultivate relationships, conduct presentations and site visits, host customer events, and showcase the property's unique offerings to prospective and existing partners.
What you'll do during a typical day:
- Solicit and uncover new business opportunities from US and international operators and travel professionals.
- Grow all accounts for Wholesale, Consortia and Cruise Lines.
- Monitor implementation of packages and offers and deploy partnerships.
- Foster relationships with agencies and individual agents to ensure ongoing communication of programs, promotions, packages, and services.
- Develop sales strategies and plan by analyzing historical, current, and future hotel and market trends.

How you'll collaborate with others:
- Partner with the Director of Sales and Director of Revenue Management to develop sales and pricing strategies aligned with market conditions and goals.
- Collaborate with the Hilton Worldwide Sales teams to identify opportunities, increase revenue, and enhance market reach.
- Develop a partnership with the Discover Puerto Rico Leisure Team to promote the destination and create business opportunities for the hotel.
- Collaborate with in-market multi-line representatives to increase hotel's visibility, cultivate client relationships, and support sales programs.

Deliverables you'll take ownership of:
- Support leisure packages, offers and promotions together with the Revenue and Marketing Teams
- Maintain customer databases; develop and implement e-marketing campaigns to promote hotel offerings, events, and property updates.
- Analyze and communicate marketing opportunities within the different accounts to secure participation in important campaigns.
- Host and direct on property Travel Partner FAM trips, site inspection and events to promote the facilities and services.
- Build additional projects and tasks assigned by your immediate supervisor.

What It Takes to Make the Stay
You have these minimum qualifications:
- Five (5) years of hotel sales experience
- Two (2) years of experience in leisure sales or retail travel sales
- Travel up to 30% of the time nationally and internationally

It would be useful if you have:
- Proficiency in Spanish
- Local market knowledge
- Experience with consortia and wholesale partners
- Experience collaborating with other hotel/resort employees, managers and directors to ensure teamwork
- Experience presenting strategic plans to senior executives and partner groups

How We'll Help You Thrive
At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:
- Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
- Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
- Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
- Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
- Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
- Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
- Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
- Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
- Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's next

*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.
Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $52,500 – $75,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.
#LI-REMOTE


The Senior Leisure Sales Manager leads efforts to expand and strengthen the hotel's leisure market presence by developing strategic partnerships with Wholesale, Consortia, and Cruise Lines accounts. You will support the Hilton Caribe and report to the Director of Sales. Through proactive business development, customer engagement, contract negotiations, and industry networking, you will increase revenue while delivering exceptional service to clients. You will travel frequently to cultivate relationships, conduct presentations and site visits, host customer events, and showcase the property's unique offerings to prospective and existing partners.

- Experience supporting multiple hotels or cluster operations is an advantage.

jobs.title: Human Resource Manager - NoMad Detroit
jobs.description:
This position serves as a trusted resource to team members and leaders and is responsible for supporting employee relations, workplace investigations, policy administration, recruitment and onboarding processes, benefits administration, workers' compensation, HR systems and records, compliance, and other employment-related programs.
The Human Resources Manager works closely with hotel leaders to promote fair and consistent employment practices, proactively address workplace concerns, maintain accurate and compliant HR operations, and create an environment in which team members feel supported, respected, and equipped to succeed.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Hospitality, Organizational Development, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant Human Resources and hospitality experience may be considered.
- Minimum three years of progressively responsible Human Resources experience required.

- Previous experience handling employee relations, investigations, policy administration, and HR operations strongly preferred.

- Supervisory or HR management experience preferred.

- Hospitality experience strongly preferred; luxury hospitality experience is a plus.

- Experience supporting a similarly sized or complex operation preferred.

Hospitality operations function seven days a week, twenty-four hours a day. The Human Resources Manager must be willing to work a flexible schedule when necessary to support team members and hotel operations.
The position requires regular interaction throughout the hotel and an active presence with team members and leaders. The Human Resources Manager is expected to model NoMad's culture, professionalism, discretion, service philosophy, and commitment to creating an exceptional workplace.
EMPLOYEE RELATIONS & MANAGER SUPPORT
- Serve as a primary day-to-day People & Development resource for team members and managers regarding workplace questions, concerns, policies, and employment practices.

- Promote positive team member relations and an environment where concerns may be raised and addressed appropriately.

- Provide guidance to managers regarding coaching, counseling, attendance, conduct, performance concerns, and application of hotel policies.

- Support the consistent and equitable administration of policies and employment practices throughout the hotel.

- Manage change requests for Compensation, Performance Management, and Objective Management through the governance process to test, deploy, and document changes to Oracle HCM platform.
- Review Oracle HCM quarterly release notes and perform impact assessments and testing for Compensation, Performance Management, and Objective Management to identify effects on existing configuration and business processes.

- Serve as a primary point of escalation for compensation, performance, and objective management technology issues, including Oracle HCM configuration questions, process defects, and data discrepancies, and manage service requests with Oracle Support to ensure resolution.
- Customize and deploy custom compensation statements within Oracle HCM to include data from Oracle HCM and Hilton-specific imagery and formatting.

Deliverables you'll take ownership of:
- Develop reports and dashboards through Oracle OTBI to provide data-driven compensation, performance, and objective management insights.
- Develop and maintain technical documentation for compensation, performance, and objective management configurations and operational procedures to support knowledge continuity and audit readiness.

- Experience with Oracle HCM data model and cross-module dependencies, between Core HR, Workforce Compensation, Performance Management and Objective Management.

- Good Communication skills.

- Commitment in delivering a high level of customer service.

- Excellent grooming standards.

- Flexibility to respond to a range of different work situations.

- Ability to work under pressure and under own initiative .

- Passion for sales and achieving targets and objectives.

- Minimum of one (3) year in   a   similar   position   with   a
luxury hotel.

- Ability   to   multi-task   and meet   deadlines

- Customer   centric

- Ability   to   demonstrate working   and   engaging teams from different cultures

- Strong   verbal   and   written communication skills along with being quality oriented with focus on details

- High performance standards

- Technical proficiency   in  related software (   excel spreadsheets, PowerPoint, Word)
Specifically, as Director of Marketing & Communication for Waldorf Astoria Maldives you will perform the following tasks to the highest standards:
Main Duties:
Administration
- To implement the Resort and Private Island’s Marketing Communications Strategy (goals, tactics and actions) to achieve and exceed forecasted revenue figures in Rooms, Food and Beverage, Spa and all other revenue generating departments.

- To organize and conduct regular departmental marketing communications meetings and ensure departmental briefings and meetings are effective.

- To represent the Sales function on the hotel's Executive Committee in the absence of the Commercial Director

Marketing
- To establish an annual and fully integrated marketing plan in a detailed calendar, with measurable objectives, strategies and action steps.

- To measure, interpret, prioritize and evaluate the effectiveness of marketing communications activities through an ROI analysis and adjust as necessary.

- To develop and maintain active contacts with the international press and key media people, and evaluate all media solicitations and exposures.

- To monitor all public statements concerning the hotel in foreign media.

- To implement new WA standard in the resort and make sure all flyers, documents, email... follow those standard

- To ensure all social media identified are well updated and monitored to assure the best positioning in hotel ranking.

- To ensure adequate targeted advertising and coverage of the hotel’s positioning, promotional programs, corporate image building and other activities.

- To ensure all hotel advertising and collateral (local Food and Beverage, Spa, etc.) are of consistent high standards, and that they comply with our hotel positioning

- To recommend and develop partnership with external partners such as credit card companies, luxury brand, banks, department stores, airlines, etc. to support the advertising and sales campaigns.

- To Target annual recognized International awards for the Resort and Private island

To closely work with Director of Spa, Director of Performance, Revenue Manager and Food and Beverage Managers to maximize use of the targeted market information including customer profile, behavior, and yield for the planning and evaluation of marketing communications.
Operational
- To closely work together with other departments to assess and support their internal and external communications needs.

- To establish and maintain the hotel library and photographic image filing

- To continuously update press kits.

- To welcome, greet and escort all Press fam trip or any media events taking place in the hotel or offsite event

- To maintain a perpetual analysis of competitor’s marketing and communication activities in the local market.

- To serve as the Webmaster for hotel’s Webpage and Internet related exposure and advertising.

- To be aware of community, business, political and social factors that may affect the hotel’s financial performance.

- To make sure other Marketing Communications associates work in a supportive and flexible manner with other departments, in a spirit of “We work through Teams”.

- To maximize associate productivity through the use of multi-skilling, multi-tasking and flexible scheduling to meet the financial goals of the business

- To proactively manage costs based on key performance indicators

- To maintain complete records of all media and purchase agreements, contracts and quotes for the hotel.

- To ensure that all hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations relating to financial record keeping, money handling and licensing are adhered to, including the timely and accurate reporting of financial information.

Customer Service
- To ensure that Marketing Department deliver the brand/resort promise and provide exceptional guest service at all times, providing positive and constructive feedback as necessary to the respective Head of Department

- To handle guest complaints and inquiries on social media in a courteous and efficient manner, following through to ensure problems are resolved satisfactorily. Keeping the respective Head of Department aware.

- To develop a culture and personality within the Hotel which encourages unique experiences and care for all parties to be their best.

Colleague Service

- Provides courteous and professional collaboration at all times.

- To assure a smooth communicate to all associates about hotel Marketing & Communications Strategy.

Personnel
- To recruit all Marketing & Communications associates. To follow hotel guidelines when recruiting and use a competency-based approach to selecting associates.

- To ensure the punctuality and appearance of all Marketing & Communications associates, making sure that they wear the correct

- uniform and maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene, according to the hotel and department’s grooming standards.

- To conduct annual Performance Development Discussions and to support Marketing & Communications associates in their professional development goals.

- To plan and implement effective training programs for Marketing Communications associates in coordination with the Training Manager and Departmental Trainers to maximize the effectiveness

- To encourage associates to be creative and innovative, challenging and recognizing them for their contribution to the success of the operation.

- To ensure Marketing Communications associates follow all hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations relating to fire and hazard safety, and security.

- To maintain strong, professional relationships with the relevant representatives from competitor hotels and other organizations.

- To respond to changes in the Marketing & Communications function as dictated by the industry, company and hotel.

- To attend training sessions and meetings as and when required.

Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts, Hilton’s luxury brand, is renowned for exceptional service, culinary excellence, and iconic destinations worldwide. Since its debut in 2019, Waldorf Astoria Maldives Ithaafushi has earned recognition as one of the world’s finest resorts. Spanning three islands, it is among the largest resorts in the Maldives, featuring 117 luxurious villas with private pools, the country’s largest spa, extensive recreational facilities, and 11 specialty dining venues—the most culinary options offered by any resort in the Maldives.

The resort also boasts the nation’s largest private island, available for exclusive hire. Surrounded by crystal-clear waters and stunning natural beauty, it offers an unparalleled luxury experience. Join our talented team and elevate your career with a world-class hospitality brand.

jobs.title: Director of Sales and Marketing - Franchise
jobs.description:
The Director of Sales & Marketing at the Hilton Richmond The Mondelle will be expected to function as the commercial architect of the hotel, building the strategy, team, relationships, reputation, and revenue foundation necessary to establish the property as one of the market’s leading luxury hotels and dining destinations. Success in this position will be measured not simply by rooms sold, but by the Director’s ability to maximize total hotel revenue, market share, profitability, restaurant visibility, client loyalty, and long-term positioning while delivering the elevated standards expected of a luxury Hilton hotel.

Pre-Opening & Commercial Strategy:

- Develop and execute a comprehensive pre-opening sales and marketing plan that creates awareness, establishes market positioning, and generates business prior to opening.

- Develop the hotel’s overall commercial strategy in partnership with the General Manager, Revenue Management, Food & Beverage leadership, and ownership.

- Conduct comprehensive market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities across transient, corporate, group, leisure, catering, social, and restaurant segments.

- Establish pre-opening revenue goals, sales production targets, account strategies, and market deployment plans.

- Build the hotel’s sales pipeline and secure base business to ensure strong opening-year performance.

- Identify and pursue citywide events, conventions, corporate accounts, social events, weddings, entertainment opportunities, and other significant demand generators.

-
Represent the hotel during pre-opening activities, industry events, community engagements, sales missions, and ownership presentations.

Sales Leadership:

- Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing luxury hotel sales and marketing team.

- Establish a culture of accountability, proactive selling, relationship development, and exceptional client service.

- Develop individual and team sales goals with measurable production expectations.

- Conduct regular sales strategy meetings, account reviews, pipeline reviews, and performance evaluations.

- Establish prospecting expectations and ensure the team consistently develops new accounts and revenue opportunities.

- Personally manage and develop relationships with key strategic accounts and high-value customers.

- Conduct executive-level sales presentations, site inspections, entertainment, and client events.

- Maintain an active presence in the local business community and relevant hospitality organizations.

Group, Meetings & Catering:

- Develop strategies to position the hotel as a premier destination for corporate meetings, conferences, weddings, social events, executive gatherings, and luxury celebrations.

- Establish relationships with meeting planners, corporations, associations, wedding planners, destination management companies, and third-party intermediaries.

- Partner with Catering and Convention Services to maximize meeting space utilization and total event revenue.

- Develop strategies that consider total account value, including guestrooms, meeting room rental, catering, audiovisual, parking, restaurant spending, and ancillary revenue.

- Ensure appropriate sales strategies are established for need periods and high-demand dates.

Restaurant & Food & Beverage Marketing:

With three restaurant concepts, the Director of Sales & Marketing will have significant responsibility for establishing each outlet as a destination within the local market.

- Partner with the Executive Chef, Director of Food & Beverage, restaurant leadership, and marketing resources to develop individual positioning strategies for all three restaurants.

- Develop restaurant launch campaigns designed to build awareness and demand before opening.

- Establish each restaurant’s unique identity, target customer, competitive positioning, and promotional strategy.

- Develop strategic partnerships with local businesses, residential communities, luxury brands, event planners, tourism organizations, and community influencers.

- Create programs that generate local patronage independent of hotel occupancy.

- Develop marketing strategies for restaurant launch events, holiday dining, events, celebrations, chef-driven experiences and promotions.

- Monitor restaurant marketing performance and adjust strategies based on revenue, covers, customer acquisition, and market response.

Luxury Brand Positioning & Marketing:

- Establish and protect a sophisticated luxury identity consistent with Hilton brand standards and the hotel’s individual market positioning.

- Develop the hotel’s annual marketing, communications, public relations, digital, social media, and promotional strategy.

- Ensure all collateral, photography, digital content, advertising, and guest-facing materials reflect a polished luxury presentation.

- Oversee hotel website content, digital campaigns, social media strategy, email marketing, and online merchandising.

- Develop compelling storytelling around the hotel’s accommodations, culinary concepts, meetings and events, amenities, and guest experiences.

- Partner with Hilton resources and external agencies as appropriate to maximize exposure and brand reach.

- Develop public relations strategies surrounding the hotel opening, restaurant launches, executive appointments, culinary programming, and major events.

Revenue & Commercial Performance:

- Partner closely with Revenue Management to establish pricing, segmentation, forecasting, and inventory strategies.

- Participate actively in weekly revenue and commercial strategy meetings.

- Analyze pace, production, booking windows, market trends, competitive performance, and future demand.

- Develop strategies to address need periods and maximize high-demand opportunities.

- Maintain accurate sales forecasts and account production reporting.

- Evaluate business based on total revenue contribution and profitability, rather than guestrooms alone.

- Ensure sales strategies support ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, group revenue, catering revenue, restaurant revenue, and overall hotel profitability.

Hilton Systems & Brand Standards:

- Maintain strong knowledge of Hilton sales systems, commercial resources, brand standards, loyalty programs, and reporting tools.

- Leverage Hilton Honors and Hilton’s global sales resources to develop incremental business.

- Maintain relationships with Hilton Worldwide Sales and appropriate regional commercial leadership.

- Ensure the sales and marketing organization complies with Hilton standards, operating procedures, and brand expectations.

- Participate in Hilton commercial programs, training, and sales initiatives as appropriate.

Ownership & Executive Leadership:

- Serve as the hotel’s senior commercial leader and trusted advisor to the General Manager and ownership.

- Prepare and present sales and marketing results, forecasts, strategies, and action plans during ownership and executive meetings.

- Develop the annual sales and marketing budget and manage expenses responsibly.

- Provide clear analysis regarding market conditions, competitive activity, business opportunities, and potential risks.

- Work collaboratively with Operations, Food & Beverage, Finance, Revenue Management, and Human Resources to achieve overall hotel objectives.

Performance will be evaluated based on measurable commercial results, including:

- Total hotel revenue

- Rooms revenue

- ADR

- RevPAR

- Occupancy

- Group room production

- Corporate negotiated account production

- Catering and banquet revenue

- Restaurant and outlet revenue

- Market share and competitive performance

- Sales pipeline development

- New account acquisition

- Account retention

- Marketing return on investment

- Pre-opening booking pace

- Opening-year revenue performance

- Guest and client satisfaction

- Sales team productivity

Job Qualifications

The ideal candidate is a sophisticated and highly driven luxury hospitality sales leader with demonstrated success in hotel openings, upscale or luxury Hilton environments, destination dining, group and catering sales, and strategic market positioning.

- Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Marketing, or related discipline preferred.

- Minimum 7–10 years of progressive hotel sales and marketing experience, including senior leadership responsibility.

- Luxury, upper-upscale, resort, or sophisticated full-service hotel experience strongly preferred.

- Hilton experience strongly preferred.

- Previous hotel pre-opening or major repositioning experience highly desirable.

- Demonstrated success managing group, corporate, leisure, catering, and social market segments.

- Strong understanding of luxury food & beverage positioning and restaurant marketing.

- Proven experience building and leading high-performing sales teams.

- Strong knowledge of hotel revenue management, forecasting, budgeting, and commercial strategy.

- Experience developing annual sales and marketing plans and presenting results to senior executives and ownership.

- Strong digital marketing, public relations, social media, and brand-positioning knowledge.

- Exceptional presentation, negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills.

- Ability to develop relationships with senior corporate executives, meeting planners, community leaders, luxury partners, and high-profile clientele.

Shamin Hotels is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. We maintain a drug free work environment and require all applicants to agree to a pre-employment background check.

The Mondelle offers a competitive salary and benefits package that includes medical, vision, dental, life insurance, short- and long-term disability and a 401k plan. We also offer paid time off, a world class hotel discount program and a fun workplace with a commitment to excellence and outstanding guest service.


Shamin Hotels, Central Virginia’s largest hotel management company, has an exceptional career opportunity for a qualified, dynamic Director of Sales & Marketing. The DOS will oversee the sales function at The Hilton Richmond The Mondelle, a Hilton Hotel and Conference Center. It will have a June 2028 grand opening and be a hub for meetings and events, sports and business travel, weddings, celebrations and leisure visitors to the Richmond region. It will serve as the centerpiece for Springline at District 60, a 42-acre mixed-use development that sits at the intersection of Midlothian Turnpike and Chippenham Parkway in Chesterfield County, Virginia.

jobs.title: Learning & Development Manager
jobs.description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work!
As a Learning & Development Manager, you are not just managing training initiatives for hotel team members , you are spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by developing our people and helping them deliver memorable experiences for every guest.
This role will be particularly important as the hotel progresses through its renovation journey and into its next chapter. You will work closely with the leadership team and department heads to support our team members throughout the transformation, maintain engagement and service standards during renovation, and build the skills, confidence, and knowledge required for the successful relaunch and operation of the renovated hotel.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality.
Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing.
Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes.
A sense of Ownership and accountability.
A focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

For this role, we are also looking for someone who is energized by transformation and change, a learning professional who can bring people along on a journey, build excitement around a new chapter for the hotel, and translate the vision of a renovated property into the skills, behaviors, and service culture our guests will experience.
Responsibilities
Here’s what you will do during a typical day:
• Develop training programs: Design, plan, and deliver hotel training programs in alignment with corporate goals and industry standards, inclusive of topics such as harassment-free workplace, diversity, new team member orientation, leadership, and service.
• Support the hotel renovation journey: Develop and coordinate learning initiatives that support team members throughout the different phases of the hotel renovation, ensuring they remain informed, engaged, motivated, and prepared for operational changes.
• Prepare teams for the renovated hotel: Partner with hotel leadership and department heads to identify new skills, service behaviors, operational knowledge, and training requirements resulting from renovated facilities, new concepts, guest touchpoints, and ways of working.
• Drive pre-opening and relaunch readiness: Develop and execute training plans ahead of the reopening of renovated areas, including service simulations, departmental training, product knowledge, guest journey training, and other readiness activities to ensure teams are fully prepared from day one.
• Embed the new guest experience: Following renovation, ensure new service standards, concepts, and operational practices are successfully embedded through continuous coaching, refresher training, observation, and follow-up.
• Support change and team engagement: Act as a learning and culture partner throughout the transformation, helping leaders communicate change effectively and supporting team members in adapting positively to the hotel’s new chapter.
• Monitor and review performance: Conduct meetings with department managers, trainers, and team members to review performance trends, develop action plans, and recognize achievements.
• Deliver continuous improvement: Assess existing training initiatives, identify opportunities for enhancement, and recommend solutions to address specific department needs.
• Manage training records: Track, maintain, and audit individual team member training records using designated systems and tools.
• Oversee departmental training programs: Manage and monitor department-specific training programs such as alcohol awareness, food safety, job skills checklists, and educational assistance.
• Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment.
As a Learning & Development Manager, you are not just managing training initiatives for hotel team members, you are spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. You will also play a key role in accompanying the hotel through an exciting period of renovation and transformation, preparing our teams for change and ensuring they are ready to deliver an exceptional guest experience in the newly renovated hotel.

jobs.title: People Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Hilton Garden Inn Almaty is looking for a People Operations (HR & Payroll) Specialist to manage payroll processes, maintain employee records, ensure compliance with Kazakhstan labor and payroll legislation, and support employees with HR-related matters. - At least 1,5 years of experience in payroll processing and HR administration.
- Practical knowledge of payroll processes and salary calculations.
- Good knowledge of the Labor Code of the Republic of Kazakhstan and payroll-related legislation.
- Understanding of payroll taxes and mandatory social contributions.
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
- Experience with 1C and in the hospitality industry is an advantage.
- High attention to detail and a responsible approach to confidential employee and financial data.
- Ability to manage large volumes of information and meet deadlines.
- Strong communication skills and an employee-focused approach.
- Willingness to develop skills in broader HR and People Operations functions.

- Verify timesheets, work schedules, leave, sick leave, bonuses, and deductions.
- Ensure accurate payroll data and compliance with Kazakhstan legislation and company policies.
- Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
- Prepare employee certificates and HR-related documents.
- Coordinate with the Accounting team on payroll, taxes, and mandatory social contributions.
- Prepare HR and payroll reports and analyze employee data.
- Act as the first point of contact for employees regarding payroll, leave, sick leave, and HR administration.
- Support employee onboarding and offboarding processes.
- Participate in HR projects and employee engagement initiatives.
- Assist with other HR operational activities as required.
People Operations Specialist is responsible for payroll processing, HR administration, and employee support at Hilton Garden Inn Almaty
